x: Anna Matthews (17:01) and Jane Pritchard (18:23) had the honour of competing in a 3Km race in which the U.K. record was smashed - Carol Tyson (Lakeland) won in 13:40!
Over the same tough course Anna and Jane placed 12th and 16th in 62:26 and 65:31 but the ladies race went to that amazing Lakeland walker Carol Tyson with 49:49.

However, Shirley and Anna Matthews started steadily and worked their way slowly through the field together to finish 11th and 12th and with young Jane Pritchard backing up well to place 24th our team closed in a pleasing 5th 1.C.Tyson (Lakeland) 24:02; 11.S.Rook 28:06; 12.A.Matthews 28:24; 24.
The winner was the diminutive Carol Tyson (Lakeland AC) in an excellent 48:21 - a time which would have given her 12th place in the mens' race!
The first Open Ladies Race to be held in conjunction saw some brilliant walking by Carol Tyson (Lakeland AC), her time would have brought her 29th position in the main race.
At the start Carol Tyson (Lakeland AC) and evergreen Judy Farr (Trowbridge) were soon leading with many hot on their heels, walking impeccably.
First home was Carol Tyson with Linda Nicholls in 7th and Tracy McDermot in 9th. Before the prize giving the oldest active athlete in Britain, if not the world, was presented to the audience.
